numeric_cap_rules.comment: Player health is always clamped to [0, 100]. Healing potions cannot exceed 100; damage cannot go below 0.

status_immutable_rules.comment: Baron Aldric was slain in the Siege of Thornwall. Once dead, resurrection is impossible — downstream plot nodes depend on his permanent absence.

location_bound_rules.comment: The Vault Key is a physical object bolted to the citadel. It can only be used or examined inside the citadel or its vault anteroom. Carrying it to another location is a hard violation.
